title: Government response to SSAC Occasional Paper 27: The influence of the social security system on educational and vocational decision-making at age 16
text:
This publication is the government’s response to the Social Security Advisory Committee’s ( SSAC ’s) Occasional Paper 27 on the influence of the social security system on educational and vocational decision-making at age 16 .

 That report looked at how the social security system interacts with the decision to remain in full-time education or pursue an alternative pathway after age 16.
